items.title: Jerry Blumberg Interview, 1961-04-06
items.q: And poor Irv didn't know what to do. He just walked into the place, and it looked like he was going to have the whole clientele on top of him.

ctx.x: You're talking about over at the saloon you went to and the... Uh, yeah, so...

...the inner loft bars. Uh, Bunk was standing there and the rest of the people, of course he was the only Negro in the bar, and the rest of the people, these rough types, they seemed to be very hostile toward him, and I was full of apprehension, you know, as I grasped the situation. And it seemed like Bunk was going to overstep the bounds of good judgment, you know, and get himself into some kind of scrape there, so I was a little scared, and I went up to him. And he was telling some kind of story to the…
And you actually heard all that talk then yourself about the Australia trip and all that.
